title: Workstream A: Multiple Testing Family Formal Registry

FAM_01_GLOBAL_ABSTENTION_88.metric_tested: Balanced Accuracy difference: Delta BA(kappa) = BA_conf(kappa) - BA_rand(kappa)
FAM_01_GLOBAL_ABSTENTION_88.null_hypothesis: H0: BA_conf(kappa) <= BA_rand(kappa) (Confidence-based abstention does not improve Balanced Accuracy over uniform random abstention)
FAM_01_GLOBAL_ABSTENTION_88.alternative_hypothesis: H1: BA_conf(kappa) > BA_rand(kappa) (Confidence-based abstention achieves superior Balanced Accuracy over uniform random abstention)
FAM_01_GLOBAL_ABSTENTION_88.raw_p_value_source: Empirical Monte Carlo uniform random subset sampling without replacement (B=2,500)
FAM_01_GLOBAL_ABSTENTION_88.coverage_100_status: Includes 11 tests at coverage 1.0 where subset equals full dataset deterministically (variance 0.0, raw p-value 1.0)
FAM_01_GLOBAL_ABSTENTION_88.post_hoc_exclusions: None. Zero hypotheses were excluded from the global family.

FAM_02_DERIVED_INSTRUMENT_SUBSET_7.audit_finding: In Phase 5.4.4, the column 'Holm Rejections: X/7' in the AU-RCC table represented the count of rejections from FAM_01 restricted to that specific instrument's 7 sub-coverage tiers. It was NOT an independently corrected 7-hypothesis family. No separate Holm correction on m=7 was executed. All rejections originated strictly from the global 88-hypothesis family.

FAM_03_AURCC_DELTA_TEST.audit_finding: No statistical hypothesis test (e.g. bootstrap or permutation test) was conducted on Delta AU-RCC. AU-RCC was evaluated solely as a deterministic trapezoidal integral over empirical risk curves. Reporting 'Holm Rejections: X/7' alongside AU-RCC created an unwarranted impression of AU-RCC statistical hypothesis testing. Delta AU-RCC values represent point estimates of risk-coverage area differences, not hypothesis test statistics.
